hero.title: See clearly before you clean.
hero.lead: A local-first macOS cleanup and system-management tool. Scan, review each item, confirm the impact, and recover by default—reclaim space without giving up control.
hero.proof: No telemetry, account, or file uploads · Cleanup never runs silently in the background

items.name: GCSA Cleaner
items.description: Works strictly within the App Store sandbox and folders you explicitly authorize.

items.note: Lite and Full are separate builds with separate security boundaries—not one app with disabled switches.

capabilities.title: From reclaiming space to reviewing system state
capabilities.description: Every capability presents the object, evidence, and impact before you choose an action.

items.title: Junk and browser cleanup
items.description: Review user caches, logs, temporary items, downloads, large files, and supported browser data. Passwords, bookmarks, history, and extensions are excluded.

items.title: Developer cleanup
items.description: Covers Xcode, node_modules, SwiftPM, CocoaPods, Homebrew, and common development or AI-tool caches with rebuild-cost context.

items.title: App management and local audit
items.description: Uninstall, reset, or review residue while inspecting local signing, Gatekeeper, notarization, sandbox, and installation evidence.

items.title: Large and duplicate files
items.description: Group by size, verify content hashes, choose a keep policy, and review in Finder. Every group retains at least one file.

items.title: Recovery center
items.description: Review recoverable transactions and restore a batch or one item. Existing files are never overwritten during recovery.

items.title: Maintenance and read-only diagnostics
items.description: Review System Data, background items, maintenance tasks, privacy permissions, device details, and activity without pretending every finding is actionable.

workflow.title: Every modification follows one safety path
workflow.description: CLEANER never treats “found” as meaning “should be deleted.”

steps.title: Read-only scan
steps.description: Identify candidates inside allowed scopes and record path, type, size, time, ownership, and scan reason.

steps.title: Item-by-item review
steps.description: A new scan selects nothing. Personal files, Downloads, large files, iCloud data, and site data never enter automatic recommendations.

steps.title: Impact confirmation
steps.description: Regenerate the plan before execution and show Trash, permanent-delete, and blocked counts. Material changes require another review.

steps.title: Execute and recover
steps.description: Report per-item outcomes and keep local history. Eligible Trash and backed-up items can be restored.

safety.title: When evidence is insufficient, execution stops
safety.description: Safety boundaries are enforced in the execution path—not left as warning copy.

points.title: Least privilege
points.description: Permissions are not required to enter the app. Missing access limits only affected capabilities, and the privileged helper accepts only allowlisted operations.

points.title: Identity revalidation
points.description: Path escape, symlink escape, post-scan identity changes, or a related running app block execution.

points.title: Recoverable by default
points.description: Ordinary files and apps prefer the Trash. Duplicate cleanup and app uninstall do not inherit a permanent-delete preference.

points.title: Honest diagnostics
points.description: Unknown provenance means local evidence is insufficient—not malicious. Activity Monitor is read-only and cannot terminate processes.

safety.note: CLEANER is not antivirus, EDR, a memory cleaner, or an automatic optimizer. It does not bypass SIP, write directly to TCC, or empty the Trash automatically.

faq.title: Set the boundaries before cleanup begins
faq.description: The product does not replace evidence with a vague “one-click optimization” promise.

items.question: Does CLEANER automatically delete scan results?
items.answer: No. A fresh scan selects nothing. Every real modification requires an explicit selection and confirmation, and destructive actions never retry automatically.

items.question: Does Mac Cleaner upload files or reports?
items.answer: No. The current product has no telemetry, account, remote scan report, or file upload. Scans, history, and device information remain on the Mac.

items.question: Does enabling permanent deletion apply everywhere?
items.answer: No. App uninstall, duplicate files, and multiple high-impact contexts force the Trash or block the operation. Preferences cannot override those safeguards.

items.question: How do Full and Lite differ?
items.answer: Full includes system cleanup, app management, recovery, and diagnostics. Lite works only in folders you authorize and always moves removed items to the Trash. They are separate builds.

capabilities.title: Cleanup, software, drivers, and security in one care suite
capabilities.description: Ten management centers cover everyday Windows care, with the object, evidence, risk, and actionable guidance behind every result.

items.title: System health check
items.description: Summarizes storage, registry, startup, network, and security state, highlights review counts, and exports a local health report.

items.title: Junk and privacy cleanup
items.description: Scans temporary files, error reports, thumbnails, browser caches, and explicit rule targets. Downloads, documents, Desktop, and cloud drives are excluded by default.

items.title: Software and preinstalled app management
items.description: Lists removable preinstalled apps for the current user without preselection, uninstalls through standard Windows APIs, and identifies explicit software removal residue.

items.title: Driver management and security checks
items.description: Verifies driver and service paths, publishers, SHA-256, and signatures, with optional YARA-X image checks. Online mode reports findings without automatically removing drivers.

items.title: Registry cleanup and repair
items.description: Finds broken startup references, uninstall residue, and explicitly invalid configuration, with complete key and value backups before changes.

items.title: Startup and performance
items.description: Reviews startup entries, scheduled tasks, and third-party services with measurable startup impact and risk evidence behind every recommendation.

items.title: System refinement and personalization
items.description: Offers curated advertising, suggestion, privacy, taskbar, Start menu, and AI-feature settings without disabling Windows Update, BitLocker, or critical services.

items.title: Network health and security
items.description: Checks adapters, DNS, proxy, Hosts, firewall, and connection metadata, then applies measurable repairs from least to most disruptive.

items.title: Deep security and anti-rootkit
items.description: Reviews persistence, signatures, drivers, services, and cross-view differences, combining PE-sieve, YARA-X, and Defender Offline into layered evidence.

items.title: History, quarantine, and item recovery
items.description: Records scans, plans, execution, and before-and-after state so quarantined files, registry backups, and configuration changes can be verified and restored individually.

workflow.title: Every system change follows one recoverable path
workflow.description: Scan results never become delete commands automatically, and high-risk objects remain review-only or move to offline inspection.

steps.title: Read-only scan
steps.description: Collect object, origin, signature, risk, and expected benefit without changing files, registry state, or network configuration.

steps.title: Evidence review
steps.description: Classify information, suggestions, safe defaults, and high-risk findings. Age or unfamiliar names are never sufficient deletion evidence.

steps.title: Backup and confirmation
steps.description: Create an immutable action plan, preserve file, registry, and network state, and show elevation and recovery requirements.

steps.title: Execute, verify, and recover
steps.description: A restricted elevation component runs allowlisted commands, verifies outcomes, records before and after state, and supports item recovery.

safety.title: Privilege, rules, and recovery boundaries are verifiable
safety.description: Safety is not a switch. It is enforced throughout scanning, planning, execution, and recovery.

points.title: Elevation on demand
points.description: The UI does not run permanently as administrator. User-scope cleanup needs no elevation; only system operations invoke the restricted component.

points.title: Signed rules and allowlisted commands
points.description: Rule packages must verify successfully, unknown fields and out-of-scope paths are rejected, and the elevated side accepts no arbitrary command line.

points.title: Revalidation before execution
points.description: The service rechecks object IDs, paths, reparse points, ownership, and rule signatures to prevent post-scan substitution.

points.title: Local quarantine and item recovery
points.description: Quarantined files, registry backups, operation logs, and recovery metadata remain local. Hash mismatches block restoration of altered content.

safety.note: Online checks never automatically delete drivers, system services, or boot-chain objects. User-mode differences require review and cannot prove or rule out a kernel-level rootkit.

faq.title: Windows maintenance needs explicit boundaries too
faq.description: CLEANER replaces scare scores and “one-click acceleration” with evidence and recoverable outcomes.

items.question: Does CLEANER automatically delete scan results?
items.answer: No. Scanning is read-only. Every modification requires object review, backup, and explicit confirmation, and high-risk security objects are never deleted automatically online.

items.question: Does it upload files, registry data, or network data?
items.answer: No. It does not upload file content, registry content, network configuration, or scan reports by default, and it does not capture packet contents.

items.question: What do software and driver management include?
items.answer: The software center lists and removes user-selected preinstalled apps and identifies explicit uninstall residue. Driver management verifies paths, publishers, hashes, and signatures and can inspect driver images with YARA-X without automatically removing drivers online.

items.question: Which Windows devices are supported?
items.answer: Windows 11 x64 and ARM64 are officially supported. Both architectures include cleanup, software management, driver checks, network, security-baseline, and recovery capabilities.

items.question: Can deep checks prove the system has no rootkit?
items.answer: No. User-mode checks can only report anomalies or differences. High-risk evidence can lead to a report and an offline scan with Defender Offline.
